The CBS March Madness studio show is a joke. DEI has ruined everything. Clark Kellogg is the only person who deserves to be there.

Video

Sherrone Moore still doing the hiring at Michigan. He has an eye for talent.


Michigan Football (@UMichFootball)

Happy to have Natalia Hilton with the program as our Director of Football Operations!

Not everything is for everybody. 

This is the equivalent of me posting a pic in speedo swim trunks and pretending I'm just like Michael Phelps. 

Peak delusion. We affirm this delusion. Sad.


Dallas Wings (@DallasWings)

Just married 💌

Congratulations @Arike_O 💍





— https://nitter.net/DallasWings/status/2035856370960863483#m

Get you a group of white boys and sprinkle some brothers around them. You're going to win in the NCAA tournament.

Video

Cinderella is dead. They're killing the American Dream, too. The pathway of coming from nothing and making it somewhere no longer exists in sports or real life.

Video

If you think a school as poor as Winston Salem State is giving anybody a 4-year basketball scholarship based off a scrimmage, you don't understand collegiate sports.  In the 1980s and early 1990s, probably 4 or 5 guys on the WSU team got full hoops scholarships. Another 2 or 3 guys got half athletic/half financial needs scholarships. The most money any of these guys got from SAS era is the money he pays them now to pretend he was on the team. His former "teammates" probably sit around laughing a

Exciting whites have taken over the NCAA Tournament, and it is symbolic of the weakening grip that Black Americans have over basketball. White Americans' and Europeans' presence in the sport continues to grow on the college and NBA level.

Video

Look at the bright side, there's a 33 percent chance something good will happen with the government. That's higher than expected.


Polymarket (@Polymarket)

BREAKING: The DHS shutdown is now projected to extend into next month — with TSA lines projected to get worse until then.  

67% chance.

The look you give when you about to drop 17 straight threes.


Stephen A Smith (@stephenasmith)

🔥🔥🔥…

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/stephenasmith/status/2036072091292676354#m

If single mothers motivated, the 'hood would be empty.


Tim McDonald (@TimMcD80)

You couldn't be more wrong. Single mothers are the greatest motivating factor for these kids to get outta the hood.



— https://nitter.net/TimMcD80/status/2035926283410935893#m

The consequence of black matriarchal culture is showing up in basketball. You see it in the NBA. You can see it clear as day in college hoops. The absence of fathers and patriarchal culture weakens EVERYTHING, including basketball.  

Purdue, Iowa, Iowa State, Illinois, Nebraska.

The matriarchy is not sustainable.

Maybe I'm not weird. Maybe I'm willing to discuss what's obvious. Maybe I'm just not scared.


Tom Maniscalco (@TSManiscalco)

You’re so weird, Jason



— https://nitter.net/TSManiscalco/status/2035893003827445851#m

Nebraska, Purdue, Iowa, Iowa State.... 

Exciting Whites have replaced Cinderella.

Peak delusion.


Rod Torfelson (@sbc0718)

What am I appreciating here, sir?



— https://nitter.net/sbc0718/status/2035887833949339846#m

Beyond killing Cinderella and CBS' DEI studio show, the story of this tournament is you're best served with 2 to 4 foundational, ain't-portaling, no-ponytail Exciting Whites in your 7-man rotation. Bill Self is one of my favorite coaches. Make sure he sees this tweet.

This is absolutely incredible!!  I had to watch it twice before I could truly appreciate it.

Video

Does No. 24 for Purdue look like a WNBA player?

I cannot get used to ponytails and manbuns. It's disconcerting.

Disagree. 

Texas has as much money to spend as any team. Not a Cinderella.


Sam Block (@theblockspot)

Texas is an 11-seed.
Texas went 9-9 in the SEC.
Texas played in the First Four.

School size means nothing.
Texas is absolutely a real Cinderella.



— https://nitter.net/theblockspot/status/2035525538010345839#m
Breaking: With Renee Montgomery out sick tomorrow,  CBS plans to showcase Jasmine Crockett for its NCAA studio show on Sunday, per sources.
